verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio is explicitly documented as a no-code, drag-and-drop tool for building/maintaining workflows without developer involvement, and document acceptance can be filtered by issuing country and document type within the dashboard. However, there is no explicit documentation of risk-based routing logic or granular conditional branching rules, nor independent/hands-on corroboration of how deep the no-code configurability goes in practice. Missing for 10: explicit risk-based routing/conditional-logic examples, independent verification that ops can fully manage this without any engineering support, and evidence of template/version management workflow.
